title: Maze, Bagels & the Park
routeText: Old Port → Mile End → La Fontaine Park → Quartier des Spectacles

steps.clueRiddle:
Two whole kilometres of twisting halls.
Can you find your way out of the walls?
steps.clueReveal: Who's ready to get lost? Ride the green line to Place-d'Armes. Find the maze hangar in the Old Port!

challenges.title: The Great Maze Escape
challenges.instructions: Stamp every checkpoint on your mission card. Then find the exit. Beat thirty minutes if you can!

steps.funFact: Two kilometres of corridors hide inside this old harbour hangar.

steps.clueRiddle:
Round bread with a hole, baked over real fire.
Watch it or taste it — racer, you choose.
steps.clueReveal: Ride the metro to Laurier, then walk to 263 Rue Saint-Viateur Ouest. Warm bagel brunch! This is a Detour: pick Watch or Taste.

a.label: Watch
a.blurb: Study the bakers at work. Learn the bagel secret, then prove it.

challenges.title: Baker Watch
challenges.instructions: Stand where you can see the bakery. Watch the bakers for a few minutes. Check off each thing you see.
checklist: A baker rolling dough by hand

challenges.title: The Bagel Secret
challenges.instructions: You just watched the bakers work. Now answer three questions. The answers are all things you saw.

trivia.q: What is added to the water Montréal bagels are boiled in?
trivia.funFact: The honey water is why Montréal bagels taste a little sweet.

trivia.q: What kind of oven bakes these bagels?
trivia.funFact: The wood fire here burns all day and all night.

trivia.q: What tool does the baker use to reach into the oven?
trivia.funFact: That paddle is called a peel, and it can hold many bagels.

b.label: Taste
b.blurb: Close your eyes and taste two bagels. Can you tell them apart?

challenges.title: Blind Bagel Test
challenges.instructions: Close your eyes while a parent hands you a bite. Guess sesame or plain each time. Then rate your favourite bagel.
checklist: At least one guess was right!
challenges.photoPrompt: Snap a picture of you eating it!

steps.funFact: St-Viateur Bagel has been baking day and night since 1957.

steps.clueRiddle:
Since 1928 the smoke has never stopped here.
Canada's most famous sandwich is waiting.
steps.clueReveal: Stroll or ride bus 55 down Boulevard Saint-Laurent to Schwartz's. Order the famous smoked meat — eat in or picnic!

challenges.title: Judge's Table: Smoked Meat
challenges.instructions: Remember the menu at Tilly's? THIS is that famous Montréal smoked meat. Taste it and give your rating.
challenges.photoPrompt: Big smoked meat bite — snap it!

steps.funFact: Schwartz's has smoked its meat on this same street since 1928.

steps.clueRiddle:
Museums are done — the racers need to run!
A big green park with a pond is waiting.
steps.clueReveal: Walk fifteen minutes over to La Fontaine Park. Time to play hard!

challenges.title: Playground Grand Prix
challenges.instructions: Start the stopwatch and play hard. Five whole minutes of playground racing. Check off each move you complete.
checklist: Spot a duck by the pond

steps.funFact: La Fontaine Park has two ponds joined by a little waterfall.

steps.clueRiddle:
The racing is done — now stroll like a local.
The Plateau hides treasures on every block.
steps.clueReveal: Wander up to Avenue du Mont-Royal. Spot the Plateau's secrets as you go. Ice cream is highly encouraged.

challenges.title: Plateau Safari
challenges.instructions: No rush — just keep your eyes open. Spot each Plateau classic as you stroll.
checklist: A cat watching from a window

challenges.title: Crémerie Cool-Down
challenges.instructions: Find an ice cream shop on the avenue. Pick any flavour you like. Give it your maple leaf rating.

steps.funFact: The Plateau's outdoor spiral staircases were built to save space inside.

steps.clueRiddle:
Lights in the ground and water that leaps.
Drums and teepees — this square never sleeps.
steps.clueReveal: Take the green line to Place-des-Arts station. Join one First Peoples' Festival activity.

challenges.title: First Peoples' Festival
challenges.instructions: Explore the festival with your team. Do at least two things from this list. Listen carefully to the drumming.

steps.funFact: The First Peoples' Festival celebrates Indigenous music, dance and film every August.

steps.clueRiddle:
The maze, bagels and the park are behind you now.
Run to the mat — this could be your day.
steps.clueReveal: Ride the metro back to Guy-Concordia. Walk to Hôtel Monroe on Rue Mackay. Step onto the pit stop mat.
steps.funFact: Tonight is your last night in Montréal — tomorrow the road goes east.
